title: An oracle with BQP equal to P-sharpP and an infinite polynomial hierarchy

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard relativized quantum/classical/promise complexity models and imported Raz–Tal Forrelation, random-projection and query bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported background statements and full original bibliography retained. Every source-local quantum simulation, concentration/restriction, oracle construction and diagonalization proof retained, including corrected v4 Lemma53.

core_obligations: Construct the layered oracle that encodes every bounded P-sharpP computation in Forrelation.
Show BQP decides the encoded counting languages with the required uniform padding.
Preserve every classical PH level through the complete conditioned hybrid argument and prove the hierarchy remains infinite.
difficulty_reason: A non-routine layered oracle construction encodes counting computations in Forrelation while retaining random Sipser instances. A conditioned infinite hybrid argument shows that the encoding leaves the full classical hierarchy infinite, even though BQP reaches P-sharpP.
